claims.claim: AutoGrow starts from a shallow seed network.
AutoGrow grows layers when validation accuracy improves.
AutoGrow stops growing when additional depth no longer improves accuracy under the learned policy.
AutoGrow achieves strong accuracy-computation trade-offs across multiple datasets.

mechanistic_notes: Growth is driven by a learned policy that evaluates accuracy gain versus computational cost.
The process is iterative: after each layer addition, the network is fine-tuned before evaluating the criterion.
